method: Actual packaged macOS CUA interaction; separately labeled native fixtures; no frontend injection.

observations.result: Keyboard e2e4 received the real a7a5 engine reply: 2 plies. Tab from Node budget explicitly focused Start. Enter started depth 8 / 5,000,000 nodes and retained Replace focus. Replacing it with depth 1 / 1,000 nodes returned a2a3 as a suggestion, not played: depth 1 / 31 nodes, still 2 plies, Start still focused.

Native Save to /private/tmp/msh37-journey.mshogi reported Saved. Cmd-Q clean exit was confirmed by empty application inventory. A fresh launch and native Open restored 2 plies and 2 observations, with engine stopped, Play Paused, and explicit Resume.

Selected the e2e4 event at 1 ply while the live game remained at 2 plies. History was labeled read only, Black to move. Depth 1 / 1,000 nodes returned a7a5 as an unplayed suggestion after 21 nodes. Return to live cleared the earlier result and focused the board. Separate Resume restored human play at 2 plies. The saved archive has 3 observations; the historical observation has exactly 1 game event, excluding future a7a5.

New game while dirty opened Save your changes with Cancel focused. Escape preserved the 2-ply game. Save succeeded; the actual native window-close button then exited, confirmed by empty application inventory.

The promotion verification title measured 760.0 x 650.0 logical content. All four choices were readable. Selecting a7-a8 opened promotion with Queen focused; Escape retained 0 plies. Reopened with the keyboard, pressed Tab three times and selected Knight: complete a7a8n accepted at 1 ply, White knight on a8, native proven-dead-position draw. Native Quit and explicit Discard closed the temporary document.

The claim fixture showed an ongoing White turn at 0 plies and an optional fifty-move claim intending a1b1, explicitly unplayed. Escape from the claim selection then Tab focused Claim. Enter concluded the claimed fifty-move draw at 0 plies and focused the actual conclusion. Native Quit and explicit Discard closed it.

The capacity fixture measured 760 x 650 and began with 255 genuine observations. Zero-work analysis accepted observation 256 as incomplete. Repeating was rejected before acceptance: Application limit explained that all 256 observations were retained, no chess result was implied, further analysis was disabled, and Save / Save as remained available. Native Save to /private/tmp/msh37-capacity.mshogi succeeded; the parsed complete archive contains 256 observations.

Native Cocoa Quit (verification), the terminate: menu entry, opened the unsaved guard with Cancel focused. Escape preserved 255 observations and 0 plies and restored Analyze position focus. Later Cmd-Q and Discard closed it. This is a Cocoa entry regression, not an actual Dock click.

Measured 760 x 650 logical content. Tab, Enter flipped to Black orientation; Tab focused i9 and scrolled the readable board into view. Keyboard i9-j10 then Tab exposed Complete action here alongside version 1 / accepted actions 0. Escape returned to i9 and cancelled. Complete 136>153>136 advanced version 2 / accepted 1 and removed j10. Tab reached Reset and the separate record. Keyboard Reset advanced version 3 / accepted 0 and retained Reset focus. Shift-Tab to the board and alternate 136>135>136 advanced version 4 / accepted 1 while retaining j10. The record profile was mshogi.synthetic.strider16.v1. Native Cmd-Q opened the fixture guard; explicit Close fixture exited.

The normal instrumentation-free host 29ec5b5c launched and keyboard e2e4 received real a7a5: 2 plies, depth 2 / 642 nodes, 0.00 from Black perspective, e4 focus retained, inspector tabs visibly full height. Cmd-Q opened the dirty guard with Cancel focused; Escape preserved 2 plies and e4 focus. The actual native window-close button opened the guard again; explicit Discard exited, confirmed by empty application inventory.

finding.pre_fix: At 760 x 650, the sticky paused card covered backward keyboard focus. Removing stickiness revealed inspector tabs still collapsed by flex shrinking. Before images are preserved.
finding.status: Resolved in the actual final package at 760 x 650: clicking Node budget then Shift-Tab twice focuses Analyze position in a visible full-height tab row. The paused card flows above it; sidebar scrolling keeps controls accessible.

limits: Screen-reader audio was not tested. Native roles/live regions, keyboard focus, and measured contrast were reviewed.
Three-platform GUI evidence remains the separate MSH-38 task.
